'''OpenAI''' is an American [[artificial intelligence]] (AI) research [[laboratory]]. It is made up of many groups. These include the [[Nonprofit organization|non-profit]] '''OpenAI Inc.''' and its for-profit subsidiary (company owned by another company) corporation '''OpenAI Global LLC'''.

[[Sam Altman]] has been chief executive officer of OpenAI since 2019 (even though he was kicked out for a little bit of time in 2023).
